profile.name: Bryan
profile.overview: Bryan is Tekken's keep-out and counter hit monster. It is scary to press buttons against Bryan due to his plethora of CH-launching attacks and high combo damage. It is scary to not press buttons against Bryan due to his strong pressure tools, lows and the infamous Taunt Jet Upper, an unblockable launcher. Playing Bryan requires demanding execution, a mastery of Tekken fundamentals, and an understanding of how to stoke tension in your opponent. The reward is one of the scariest characters to press a button against in the entire game.
profile.playstyle: Keep-out and counter hits. Stand at mid range, make the opponent scared to press with his counter-hit launchers (b+1, f+3, 3+4, ws3, qcb+1), and punish hard. His backdash is poor, so control space with spacing and his long pokes rather than running away.
strengths: The REAL Counter Hitting Paragon: Strong counterhit moves and strings (e.g., 3+4, 1,2,1, b+1, f+3) that reward timing and punish aggression.
A literal truck: High damage from combos and mixups, tremendous wall carry.
"Die!" Can launch punish -14 moves from standing with Jet Upper.
True Zoning: Very strong moves to play keepout (e.g., 3+4, qcb+1, d+4)
Suffocating: Devastating okizeme at the wall with taunt and its follow-ups.
He's on fire: Snake Eyes moves are incredibly powerful, especially in Heat where they can be used with impunity.
weaknesses: Slow: Possesses a bad backdash cancel, on top of needing proper inputs due to backsway.
Surprisingly soft: His standing i10-i13 punishes are middling at best.
Rigid: His panic moves leave a little bit to be desired.
Inconsistent: Awkward hitboxes on some key moves, and Jet Upper being a high is sometimes detrimental.
Technical: Requires difficult execution to optimize, especially when it comes to Taunt followups.

stances.name: Slither Step
stances.note: SLS.1+2 is a Heat Engager; SLS.2,4 and SLS.4,1,4 tornado. b+3 can enter it with f.

stances.name: Sway
stances.note: SWA.1 (qcb+1) is an i13 high that is +1 on block and launches on counter hit (+72a); it also wall-splats.

stances.name: Snake Eyes
stances.entry: 1+3+4, Heat, or moves like uf+3+4 on hit
stances.note: Wavu: Heat gives access to Snake Eyes moves.

heat: Gains access to Snake Eyes moves.

keyMoves.gamePlan: Your fast punish; Wavu notes his i10-i13 punishes are middling.

keyMoves.purpose: His mid check and the start of df+2,1 (i13 punish).

keyMoves.summary: i14 mid elbow, -2 on block, spikes.
keyMoves.purpose: A safe mid that spikes and can transition to crouch.
keyMoves.use: Close range when the opponent ducks.

keyMoves.summary: Jet Uppercut: i14 tornado launcher, -7 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: His i14 launch punisher, safe on block.
keyMoves.gamePlan: His best punisher: practise the input until it is automatic.

keyMoves.use: After lows that are -15 or worse.

keyMoves.summary: i12 while-standing knee, launches on counter hit.
keyMoves.purpose: A fast crouch punisher with a CH launch.
keyMoves.use: After -12 lows, or when they press.

keyMoves.summary: Chopping Elbow: i20 mid, +4 on block, launches on counter hit (+78a).
keyMoves.purpose: His famous CH launcher that is plus on block.
keyMoves.use: At range when you expect the opponent to press or step in.
keyMoves.counterplay: Do not press into it; sidestep or wait.
keyMoves.gamePlan: The heart of his keep-out game.

keyMoves.summary: Knee Strike: i16 mid, +0 to +2 on block, launches on CH (+50a).
keyMoves.purpose: A safe, plus mid with a CH launch.
keyMoves.use: To keep the turn and punish presses.
keyMoves.counterplay: Block it and do not press after.

keyMoves.summary: Middle Side Kick: i18 mid, launches on counter hit (+59a).
keyMoves.use: At mid range against people who step in.

keyMoves.summary: Knee Break: i16 mid, wall splat (Wavu).
keyMoves.purpose: An i16 punisher that splats at the wall.

keyMoves.summary: Snake Edge: i29 homing low, launches (+70a), -26 on block.
keyMoves.use: As a read on standing block.

keyMoves.summary: Mach Breaker: i13 high, Heat Engager, wall splat.
keyMoves.use: To whiff punish and start Heat.

keyMoves.summary: Guillotine: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.

combos.name: Tornado BnB: 4,1 1 b+2,1~F SLS.2,4
combos.situation: After a tornado launch such as df+3 or a counter-hit qcb+1 (Wavu).
mistakes: Holding F too late after b+2,1: SLS has to start straight away.
Pressing 4,1 before the opponent has turned in the air.
